_format: Demo MP profiles for person search. 3 MPs covering Labour, Conservative, and Lib Dem. Each has photo (Wikimedia Commons CC), bio, TheyWorkForYou + Parliament + Wikipedia links. Results timeline lives in results.json under by_person.

lisa-nandy.name: Lisa Nandy
lisa-nandy.role: Secretary of State for Culture, Media and Sport
lisa-nandy.bio: Labour MP for Wigan since 2010. Secretary of State for Culture, Media and Sport since July 2024.
lisa-nandy.person_summary: Nandy has consistently centred her recent statements on housing security and renter protection, voting with the Labour front bench on the Renters' Rights Amendment.

citations.quote: Decent housing is a foundation, not a privilege.

robert-jenrick.name: Robert Jenrick
robert-jenrick.role: Shadow Lord Chancellor and Secretary of State for Justice
robert-jenrick.bio: Conservative MP for Newark since 2014. Shadow Lord Chancellor and Secretary of State for Justice.
robert-jenrick.person_summary: Jenrick has focused recent statements on immigration enforcement and rental market reform, opposing the Renters' Rights Amendment in March 2026.

citations.quote: Reform must work for renters and landlords. Tilting the field destroys both.

daisy-cooper.name: Daisy Cooper
daisy-cooper.bio: Liberal Democrat MP for St Albans since 2019. Deputy Leader and Health spokesperson.
daisy-cooper.person_summary: Cooper has championed landlord licensing and tabled the Lib Dem amendment to require a national register, while also pressing for NHS waiting-time targets.

citations.quote: A national register of landlords is the floor, not the ceiling.
